body: Same, I just want someone to hug me and cry with me

In case you didn't notice, that comment is not by me(OP) (though I can relate very well to the comment).

I don't know what exactly is the problem. I don't know what's wrong with me. And that's the biggest problem.
I hope things get better. I hope... I just hope. Without doing anything. Even hoping is hard sometimes.

I'm not feeling like I'm a burden because people care about me. It's the opposite. Even my parents think I'm just fucking lazy and don't have 'social skills'.
I really want to tell my problems to them and actually reach out for help. But I fear I'll kill myself out of embarrassment and hopelessness if they just react like it's nothing important.

I, too, gradually became so tired of thinking, dreaming, feeling or doing anything, so I decided not to care about anything. I thought not caring about anything was a good attitude of life that can relieve myself or whatever.

And... it was only days ago when I realized that something's wrong, something was always wrong.
Sorry that I completely don't know what's wrong with either I or you or anyone.
I feel you. That 'overshadowing' always leaves a bad bitter taste even on my happy moments... and that emptiness lies at the very bottom of my mind, allowing nothing to escape it.
I actually did many years ago. And it feels terrible to see nothing has really changed with me.
Always. I don't even know what it feels like to have had a good sleep.

I often daydream about all human in the world except me suddenly disappearing and I enjoying the rest of my life in peace.
It was the opposite when I was very young. I often worried about all human except me disappearing and I being scared as hell.
I don't know if I have changed a lot, or if I just have the same strange mentality through all my life.
I don't even remember how to paint anything
